Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 earnings performance with consolidated revenue of INR2,013 crores and a 78% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted improvement in gross margins driven by a shift toward Advance Gold, non-22 KT jewelry, and studded jewelry segments, alongside positive operating cash flows of approximately INR30 crores. The company maintained its long-term vision of reaching INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30 while continuing to pursue disciplined working capital and debt reduction. Management reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching ₹2,012.8 crore and PAT touching ₹104.9 crore, marking significant year-on-year growth. The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to approximately ₹8,100 crore, backed by margin expansion, growing contributions from value-added and advance gold products, and expanding export opportunities.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue projection upwards to approximately ₹8,100 crore.
Management expects the EBITDA margin for FY27 to be in the range of approximately 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: • EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: The PAT margin for FY27 is guided to be between 4.5% and 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to be around ₹18,000 to ₹19,000 crore.
By FY30, advance gold is expected to contribute approximately 30% of total volumes.
guidance.quote: By FY30, advance gold is expected to contribute ~30% of volumes, is 11.5% in FY26.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management projects a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects to increase its export share to 20% in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we are expecting good sales export as we have guided that we will go to 20% exports in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes strong structural demand tailwinds across natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, and Advance Gold.
demand_outlook.quote: The continued expansion of our premium product portfolio, coupled with our capital-efficient growth strategy reinforces our confidence in delivering sustainable and profitable growth with strong tailwind across natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds and Advance Gold.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers have reported that gold exchange has increased from 20% to over 40%.
demand_outlook.quote: We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above. The regular rate is 20% gold exchange business, it has gone to 40%.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity utilization is around 60%, leaving 40% headroom for growth.
capex_expansion.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility expansion after 2028 will likely follow an asset-light leased model requiring INR80 crores to INR100 crores in capex.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's manufacturing footprint has expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: • Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted the opening of a Dubai office to support international expansion.
The company is planning land monetization for the current factory by August end or September last.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies also. We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased by 27 basis points sequentially to 9.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: The share of value-added products surged from under 10% in FY23 to approximately 50% to 55% in FY26, acting as a primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: • Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Operational efficiencies from implementing an ERP system led to a reduction in gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.
margins_costs.quote: • Operational Excellence: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: Interest expenses currently account for 1.25% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Today, interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales, which is a significant drag.

margins_costs.claim: The FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Our FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Participation in the UK jewellery expo resulted in a prospective order pipeline of INR30 crores to INR45 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.
So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So again, 1.2-ton capacity we have, we are 650 kg last quarter exit.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flows turned positive at close to INR30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stood at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt is expected to be reduced by over 50% in FY27 through land sale and operational improvement.
capital_allocation.quote: We would be reducing net debt by 50% above in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: The wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness resulting from tightening macroeconomic conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness as a result of this tightening conditions, Sky Gold business model is explicitly built to thrive in such an environment.

management_commitments.claim: Management will review and revise the FY27 revenue guidance after Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model starting in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reducing net debt by over 50% in FY27 through land sale and operational improvement.
management_commitments.quote: We would be reducing net debt by 50% above in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to encash the land monetization by August end or September last.
management_commitments.quote: We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
